question.problem:
Given that $X$ is a continuous random variable with the following probability density function, compute $\text{E}[X].$

$$
f(x)=\{\begin{aligned}\frac{1}{2}, & 0<x<1 \\ \frac{3{x}^{2}}{14}, & 1\le x<2\end{aligned}
$$
question.worked_solution:
For a continuous random variable $X$ with probability density function $f(x)$ defined over a set $S,$ we can calculate the expected value using the following formula:

$$
\text{E}[X]={\int }_{S}x\cdot f(x)\,\text{d}x
$$

 

We compute the expected value of $X$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{E}[X] & ={\int }_{0}^{2}x\cdot f(x)\,\text{d}x \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}x\cdot f(x)\,\text{d}x+{\int }_{1}^{2}x\cdot f(x)\,\text{d}x \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}x\cdot \frac{1}{2}\,\text{d}x+{\int }_{1}^{2}x\cdot \frac{3{x}^{2}}{14}\,\text{d}x \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}\frac{x}{2}\,\text{d}x+{\int }_{1}^{2}\frac{3{x}^{3}}{14}\,\text{d}x \\  & ={\frac{{x}^{2}}{4}|}_{0}^{1}+{\frac{3{x}^{4}}{56}|}_{1}^{2} \\  & =\frac{1}{4}+\frac{45}{56} \\  & =\frac{59}{56}\end{aligned}
$$
